=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/unblock_actions.py:990-996 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: When a reissue goes ahead with an open CI-owner PR, `_own_pr_retire_ops` keeps that PR and the replacement is routed onto its head `ai/issue-<item>` (scripts/unblock_actions.py:1632-1636). The source issue is then closed as `not_planned` (:1679-1683), so the G4 source-issue guard treats the kept PR as an orphan (scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:3949-3952; scripts/review_merge_train.sh:2476-2480 and :2955-2962) and the PR can never get the merge lease.
  WHY: The tick reads issue `<n>` as NOT_PLANNED, logs `MERGE_LEASE ... outcome=skipped reason=source_issue_not_planned` and removes the wait label. The update-mode gate refuses a lease with "no grant will come" (scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2622-2625), and `_pr_base_fresh_for_merge` returns `lease_wait` forever, so the integration branch is stranded with no re-dispatch path. The source severity was MAJOR, mapped here to high.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: “When a `reissue` goes ahead and the issue has an open own pull request that is not green, the operations also comment on that pull request and close it.”

  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: `_own_pr_retire_ops` explicitly skips the open CI-owner PR when its number matches `keep` (lines 989-995), and `tests/test_unblock_judge.py:test_open_ci_owner_pr_is_never_retired` confirms the pending own PR stays open. The re-issue still closes the source issue as not planned (`plan()`, lines 1679-1683), after which the lease guard treats the retained `ai/issue-<n>` PR as orphaned and skips it (`scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh`, lines 3949-3952; `scripts/review_merge_train.sh`, lines 2476-2480).
- requirement: G4 gets MERGE_LEASE_SOURCE_ISSUE_GUARD_ENABLED, default true.
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml, in the environment for the final-CI base-sync step that calls the update-mode lease gate
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: That step forwards MERGE_LEASE_REVOKE_ENABLED but not MERGE_LEASE_SOURCE_ISSUE_GUARD_ENABLED. The base-sync path can renew a merge lease, and the helper treats an unset source-issue switch as enabled, so setting the repository switch to false does not disable the guard on this path.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

- scripts/unblock_actions.py:990-996 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  Line or code reference: `_own_pr_retire_ops` keep rule at scripts/unblock_actions.py:990-996 (`keep = owner["number"] if owner and owner.get("state") == "open" else None`), the reissue path at scripts/unblock_actions.py:1632-1636 (`- Integration branch: \`{owner['head_ref']}\``) and :1679-1683 (source issue closed as `not_planned`), versus the G4 guard selection at scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:3949-3952 and the tick skips at scripts/review_merge_train.sh:2476-2480 and :2955-2962.
  PROBLEM: A reissue with an open CI-owner PR routes the replacement onto that PR's head (`ai/issue-<item>`, scripts/unblock_actions.py:1636), and `_own_pr_retire_ops` keeps it (scripts/unblock_actions.py:990) while the source issue is closed as `not_planned` (:1679-1683). The G4 guard then classifies the PR as an orphan (head matches `^ai/issue-[1-9][0-9]{0,8}$` at scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:3951), so the tick skips and unlabels it and the update-mode gate refuses a lease with "no grant will come" (scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2622-2625). The PR can never merge.
  WHY: Reissue of an issue whose `ai/issue-<n>` PR is open but not green (the #9519/#9562 shape, exercised by `test_open_ci_owner_pr_is_never_retired`) → replacement implements on `ai/issue-<n>` → PR re-enters the lease queue → tick reads issue `<n>` as NOT_PLANNED → `MERGE_LEASE ... outcome=skipped reason=source_issue_not_planned`, wait label removed → `_pr_base_fresh_for_merge` returns `lease_wait` forever → the PR stalls at the lease with no re-dispatch path.
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
